_comment: Default source-tier classification. The sub-agent uses this to score each cited URL. Tier 1 = primary, highest credibility. Lower tiers require explicit justification or downgrade flags.

1.label: Primary / official
examples: Government / regulator publications (SEC, FDA, BAFin, FINMA, EU)
Official company docs (10-K, prospectus, product docs)

2.label: Established secondary
examples: Reuters, AP, BBC, FT, WSJ, Bloomberg
Established trade press (The Verge, Ars Technica, Krebs on Security)
Wikipedia (use as index, never as sole citation)

3.label: Tertiary / community
examples: Reddit, Hacker News, Twitter/X, LinkedIn posts
Personal blogs, Substack without editorial track record
3.rule: May be cited only when (a) no tier-1/2 source addresses the claim, AND (b) explicitly flagged as tier-3 with reasoning.
